name: state-procurement-bids
title: State Procurement Bids Scraper (RFP, IFB, RFQ)
description: Collect open public-sector solicitations (RFPs, IFBs, RFQs, RFIs) from US state procurement portals (COMMBUYS, NJSTART, OregonBuys, Georgia GPR, Iowa, LaPAC) in one normalized JSON schema: agency, dates, NIGP/UNSPSC codes, buyer contact, attachments. No login, pay per solicitation.
